Review from an existing customer

I have been a customer of BraByggare for several years. I have previously cancelled the service once, but was then offered a cheaper contract to stay. I chose to give the service another chance. Unfortunately, my experience has not improved.

When I wanted to cancel the subscription again, I discovered that the contract had been automatically extended for another year. Since billing is done quarterly, I only discovered this about three months later.

I have both written and called twice to try to find a solution, but BraByggare refuses to terminate the contract early and simply refers to the contract having been extended.

What makes the situation extra frustrating is that I do not feel that the service provides any real value for my company. BraByggare refers to the fact that I have responded to nine jobs since March, but clicking “reply” does not mean that there are actually nine relevant or realistic business opportunities.

My experience is that many requests either have unrealistic budgets, come from people who are mainly collecting quotes, or simply don't lead anywhere. Once an interesting and relevant job appears, it can instead be full within an hour or so because the maximum number of companies have already responded.

A concrete example was a customer who wanted a pool excavated and built and told me that he had received a price of just over SEK 100,000 for the work. My realistic price for the excavation and ground work itself was around SEK 130,000–150,000. That says a lot about the difference between the type of requests that are mediated and the jobs that are actually commercially interesting for my company.

I understand very well that I have entered into a contract and that there are contract terms. What I find difficult to understand is why you want to keep a long-standing customer who clearly says that the service doesn't work for him, no longer wants to use it and sees no value in it.

After several years as a customer, I am therefore leaving this review because the whole experience has unfortunately made me lose confidence in the service. Instead of feeling that BraByggare is helping my company find work, I feel stuck in a subscription that I do not want and have no use for.

That is simply not how I think a long-term customer relationship should be ended.

one_star_reviews.text:
Too bad you can't give minus points.

Last year my cat was at Ekeby Djurpraktik for a PTR and x-rays for TR/forl. Five teeth had to be removed and a few days later it became infected in the mouth (which I know is a risk). At the return visit I had to fill out their form as before where I can, among other things, fill in the amount over the already planned procedures I agree to pay before they will call me. Several hours pass before the vet calls me and says that she has had to do more procedures in my cat's mouth and that the price has already exceeded the amount I wrote by several thousand SEK, so the vet called AFTER and not before. I would never have refused them to do the procedures that are needed as long as my cat is well, but they have no idea about my finances and whether I even have the money on me, or if I have to solve it somehow. I briefly question this over the phone, but on the way to pick up my cat, I realize that this really bothers me. Once there, when I question this, I feel that the vet instead becomes questioning towards me. Among other things, the vet says something like that I am not thinking about my cat's best interests first and foremost, since I seem to be okay with letting my cat lie sedated for an unnecessarily long time so that she will run out and call me. Someone at the reception could have called. They also said that the amount for the planned procedures that day was already higher than what was written, but also the amount I had written there, but they had no good explanation for why no one told me about this in advance. There were several questionable things said during this conversation that lasted about 30 minutes, which felt embarrassing on their part, since I had been completely okay with an apology and a discount. It gets even funnier when I see the invoice and that the vet had quoted a lower amount over the phone and that it was actually about double what I had originally agreed to. I end up getting a discount of about 40-45%, but never an apology.

I had let this incident go until today.
Today my cat went for another PTR (at a different clinic!), and there the vet could see on an x-ray that a tooth was damaged. She thought that this damage was due to the fact that this tooth root had previously been accessed with a drill. This tooth was located (it was removed today) right next to one of the teeth that Ekeby had done a crown amputation on in November 2025. This tooth was also one of the teeth that the vet had had to grind down the root even more on during the second visit when the infection occurred. However, I leave it unsaid whether this damage that was seen today was due to the vet at Ekeby.

While I'm at it, I can also mention that I ran to Ekeby Djurpraktik several times in the spring of 2025 when my cat had more diffuse symptoms. It was always a "you have to come back if it doesn't get better", which I was sad to hear. With my cat's blood tests/symptoms, I was able to figure out that she had a thyroid problem, but I thought it was hypothyroidism because of several of her symptoms. When I brought this up with (another) veterinarian, I got the answer that it is so unusual for cats to have hypothyroidism that she thought it sounded completely unlikely. However, I insisted on blood tests because I had read that high ALT is often seen in cats with thyroid problems (my cat's ALT was closer to 800). After the blood test, she was diagnosed with hyperthyroidism. I have no training in healthcare and I myself have a healthy thyroid, so figuring out my cat's illness felt quite frustrating. It cost x number of 1000 SEK for visits to Ekeby, for ultrasound at Ultuna and a stressed cat - completely unnecessarily. As an amateur, I could google what blood tests were recommended in this case. It is easy to be wise in hindsight, but I should have changed vets already after this incident. Strongly advise against Vinden.

We chose Vinden even though we had read mixed reviews. Unfortunately, the negative reviews turned out to be extremely consistent with our own experience.

The estimate we received before booking was not even close to what the final amount was. In our case, the cost was more than twice as high as we expected. Vinden markets itself as you only pay for the space you use and that there are no hidden fees, but it was exactly the opposite in our experience.

When our things had been measured, it turned out that the charged volume was almost twice as large as the estimate from their own calculator, we had indeed added additional volume but not close to double. I contacted customer service who, after A LOT of arguing, agreed with them that the difference seemed unreasonable. We received a minor price adjustment, but far from sufficient.

Another thing that is in the fine print but is not communicated anywhere; If your stuff is left in the warehouse for just one day into a new calendar month, you will have to pay for the entire month. So if you drop off your stuff on January 31st and pick it up on March 1st, you will pay for three full months. Reasonable? Well..

At the final delivery, an item was delivered damaged to the new home. At that point, I didn't even have the energy to have another discussion with them.

The whole experience left a very sour aftertaste. Choose Grabbarna flytt or Jordgubbsprinsen instead – the first quote will look more expensive, but it will be cheaper in the end, and you will avoid all the hassle.
